title: The platform engineer ships the fix as a new digest and records it as the successor of the old one, with the fail date

The platform engineer finds every service built from the superseded digest
The service author of each affected service takes the fix into the service by a pin bump and a new run
The agent starts the service's declaration from an archetype
The agent asks STEGO to check the declaration, and STEGO reports every fault
The agent repairs the declaration from the refusal alone and checks it again, until STEGO accepts it
The service author qualifies each fill the declaration binds, and signs its test evidence with their own key
The platform engineer composes a registry for the team, with a local registry for the team's own components
The service author contributes the team's component upstream, and the platform team accepts it into the common registry at alpha
The platform engineer graduates the component to ga when it meets the quality bar
The platform engineer retires the component, after naming every service that uses it

The platform engineer curates a golden path that includes the graduated component
